description: Colorado Electrical Transmission Grid is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. Shapefile containing transmission network of Colorado. Coordinate System: Universal Transverse Mercator (UTM) WGS 1984 Zone 13N, Linear Unit: Meter, Angular Unit: Degree, Prime Meridian: Greenwich. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Electricity. Its keywords are electrical transmission, geothermal. The portal shows 2026-04-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
